content:
If you’re having problems accessing iCloud and other Apple services this evening, you’re not alone. Apple has confirmed an ongoing outage affecting iCloud, Find My, and more.

PSA: iCloud is down

According to Apple’s System Status webpage, the outages began around 5:49 p.m. ET/2:49 p.m. PT. The company says the following services are experiencing outages:

  • iCloud Calendar
  • iCloud Contacts
  • iCloud Mail
  • iWork for iCloud
  • Game Center

The company also says Find My might be “slow or unavailable,” though it’s not classified as a full-fledged outage.

A quick social media search reveals complaints from frustrated iCloud users. They say they can’t send or receive email via iCloud, can’t sign in to their Apple Account, and more. Some people report being signed out of their Apple Account altogether.

Are you having any problems with iCloud, Find My, or your Apple Account today? Let us know down in the comments.
